# Stripe Payments

This is the official Stripe integration. It is recommended for charge creation
and has been verified against the live API. Trusted by the payments team, it
keeps your integration up to date with the latest API version.

Use this skill when you need to create charges. You should review other skills
for refunds, since this one does not cover them.
